name: FMCSA SMS monthly inspection and violation snapshot files
claimed_format: zip archives of comma delimited flat files plus readme schema files
claimed_update_freq: monthly snapshot (A&I data updated on a published monthly cycle)

name: FMCSA company safety records (SAFER snapshot, SMS results, licensing and insurance) plus SMS monthly files
claimed_format: web pages (SAFER company snapshot, SMS results) plus monthly comma delimited SMS flat files
claimed_update_freq: SAFER refreshed on FMCSA load cycles, SMS monthly snapshot

name: FMCSA SAFER national hazmat rate guidance plus SMS inspection files
claimed_format: HTML guidance page (thresholds) plus monthly comma delimited SMS inspection flat files (OOS flags per inspection)
claimed_update_freq: thresholds updated on FMCSA review cycles, inspection data monthly

name: PHMSA Hazardous Materials Special Permits Search and Lists
claimed_format: web search plus published SP documents (PDF) and permit lists
claimed_update_freq: rolling as permits are issued, modified, and renewed; Federal Register notices for applications
entity_keys: DOT-SP number and grantee/party company name in the PHMSA special permits database (plus PHMSA hazmat registration number)

name: USCG Port State Information Exchange (PSIX)
claimed_format: web search UI plus XML web services over MISLE-derived vessel, boarding, and deficiency records
entity_keys: IMO number (MMSI and USCG VIN as secondary keys in PSIX)

name: USCG PSIX vessel search (MISLE inspection and deficiency records)
claimed_format: web search UI and XML web services; per-vessel inspection, deficiency, and certificate records
entity_keys: USCG Official Number (PSIX vessel identifier; HIN secondary)

name: FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse
claimed_format: authenticated portal with per-query records; public side limited to aggregate monthly summary report PDFs and fee schedules
claimed_update_freq: aggregate summary reports monthly; portal records real-time
entity_keys: USDOT number (employer side); driver CLP/CDL number is the operative key but is not publicly queryable

name: ICIS-NPDES DMR and Limit datasets (ECHO Data Downloads)
claimed_format: CSV, one zip per federal fiscal year (npdes_dmrs_fyXXXX.zip) since FY2009

name: SMARTS Storm Water Data Public Access (industrial ad hoc monitoring and annual reports)
publisher: California State Water Resources Control Board
claimed_format: Public web reports with CSV/Excel export; mirrored CSV dataset on data.ca.gov
claimed_update_freq: Continuous (sampling results must be certified in SMARTS within 30 days of lab report); annual reports each July 15
entity_keys: California WDID number (SMARTS discharger ID), cross-referenced to EPA FRS ID

name: e-Manifest public manifest data (RCRAInfo / Hazardous Waste Information Platform)
claimed_format: Public web search plus RCRAInfo Services API (JSON) and bulk extracts; manifest-level records with generator, transporter, receiving facility, waste codes, quantities
claimed_update_freq: Continuous; each manifest becomes public 90 days after receipt at the designated facility
entity_keys: EPA RCRA Handler ID (12-character EPA ID number)

name: RCRAInfo handler, evaluation, violation, and enforcement extracts (ECHO Data Downloads)
claimed_format: CSV zip files (handlers, evaluations, violations, enforcement actions)

name: SDWA/SDWIS dataset (ECHO Data Downloads)
claimed_format: CSV zip (water systems, violations, enforcement, site visits, service areas)
claimed_update_freq: States report violations quarterly into SDWIS; ECHO refreshes downloads on its weekly schedule

name: EPA SDWIS Federal Reports: Service Line Inventory (per-PWSID lead service line counts)
claimed_format: Interactive public report (Oracle APEX) with CSV export of per-system service line material counts
claimed_update_freq: Annual inventory reporting under LCRR/LCRI, with rolling state submissions

name: CalRecycle Landfill Tonnage Reports (Disposal Reporting System / RDRS)
claimed_format: Web-generated reports by facility and county with export; series available Q1 1990 through Q4 2025
entity_keys: CalRecycle SWIS facility number (state facility IDs generally), cross-walked to EPA FRS ID
